response.original_title: {✦ FAQS&Guide✦} How do I add a passenger on MSC Cruise?
response.overview: To add a passenger to an existing MSC Cruise, you  ☎︎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS)  must call MSC directly at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or contact your travel agent. To add someone to an existing room on a MSC Cruise,  ☎︎ +61-1800-009-384 (AUS)  you must call MSC customer service directly or contact your travel agent, as this cannot be done online or through the mobile app. Reach out to MSC Cruises at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK), or call your original booking agent. To add someone to a room on a MSC Cruise, you must call MSC Cruises Customer Service directly at +1-866-829-1280 (US/Canada) or +44-204-586-5316 (UK), or contact your original travel advisor.
